HOUSE.meaning: A business's own rule, signed in its Authority package; refused if it relaxes the floor. Reserved: not admitted until a grammar version enables it.

LAW.meaning: A paragraph of law; the condition cites the node it encodes.

PLATFORM.meaning: Labelled platform policy, carried by package #0.

condition.basis: { kind: one of BASES, ...that basis's required keys }
condition.event: EVENT or EVENT_LIST: the events the condition applies to.
condition.id: A unique id within the package, e.g. cond.<name>.
condition.vectors: A non-empty list of { name, input, expect: PASS | REFUSE }; admission runs every vector on every evaluator.

compare.decides: A number or date at a path against a constant or the value at another path, of the same kind. Refused when either side is absent or not comparable, unless ifPresent and the path is not recorded.

custody.decides: Who holds legal and physical custody after the event.

firstOnBook.decides: When the book (PROPOSER: the entry's own; ANY: the whole chain) has no earlier entry on the subject, the entry must be one of the allowed events. A per-licence rule is one condition per licence, chosen by when on tenantContext.type.

inSet.decides: A path's value is one of a declared set.

invariant.decides: A custody-state invariant that holds after every event it names.

matches.decides: The string at a path matches the declared pattern. Refused when it is absent or not a string, unless ifPresent and it is not recorded.

matchesChain.decides: The fields equal the same fields on the latest earlier entry on the chain of one of the events (sharing the key, when given). Refused when there is none, unless the entry may open the chain.

notWhileHeld.decides: Refused while the book still holds the subject: after its last entry of a holds event, unless a later entry of a releases event ends the holding. A release counts unless the first recorded recipient path names the book's owner (tenantContext.tenantId); a release with no recipient recorded counts.

oneOf.decides: At least one shape is fully present.

onlyFirst.decides: The event is only ever a chain's first entry.

since.decides: An earlier entry of one of the step events is on the book since the reference point: CHAIN_START, anywhere; LAST_HELD, after the book's last entry of a holds event (holds required). When recipient is given, a step counts only if the first recorded recipient path names the book's owner (tenantContext.tenantId).

operandTypes.DATE: A calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (its UTC midnight) or an ISO 8601 timestamp; a date that does not exist (2019-02-30) is not a date.
operandTypes.EVENT: An event the package defines. An event named as an operand (holds, releases, step, allowed) may instead be one the platform defines: package #0's steps and powers. The events a condition applies to (event) are always its own package's.
operandTypes.NUMBER_OR_DATE: A NUMBER or a DATE. Both sides of a comparison must be the same kind.
operandTypes.PATH: A field path the event defines (admission refuses an unknown path).
operandTypes.PATTERN: An anchored regular expression (^...$), at most 200 characters, with no quantified group (no nested repetition), so it always runs in bounded time.
operandTypes.SCALAR: A string, finite number, boolean or null.
operandTypes.SHAPE_LIST: A non-empty list of PATH_LIST: one shape must be fully present.

reads.BOOK: The entries on the subject's chain made by this book (the proposer's ledger instance).
reads.CHAIN: The subject's chain, oldest first, through the kernel's ledger view (sealed by head version).
reads.CUSTODY: The subject's custody state before the entry, and after it.
reads.ENTRY: The proposed entry: its event, sealed fields and metadata.
